candidates.label: A
candidates.summary: Very complete and implementable, with strong coverage of delivery semantics, tenant isolation, persistence, security, observability, tests, and open decisions. Main weakness is length and some ceremony beyond what is needed.

candidates.label: B
candidates.summary: Strongest overall balance. It cleanly separates requirements, assumptions, open decisions, risks, and acceptance criteria while avoiding invented SLA numbers. Minor ceremony remains, but most content is useful and actionable.

candidates.label: C
candidates.summary: Concise and mostly accurate, with good traceable requirements and acceptance criteria. It is less complete on delivery/data model details, launch controls, and implementation contracts than A or B, but does not materially contradict the brief.
